title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省 Oton 市镇 Caboloan Sur 描笼涯的 Oton 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Cambitu 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Oton National High School - Cambitu Extension in Barangay Caboloan Sur, Municipality of Oton, Province of Iloilo From the Oton National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Cambitu National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Oton National High School - Cambitu Extension in Barangay Caboloan Sur, Municipality of Oton, Province of Iloilo From the Oton National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Cambitu National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Cambitu của Trường Trung học Oton Quốc gia tại Barangay Caboloan Sur, Đô thị Oton, Tỉnh Iloilo khỏi Trường Trung học Oton Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Cambitu Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Cambitu ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Oton แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Caboloan Sur เทศบาล Oton จังหวัด Iloilo ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Oton แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cambitu แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Cambitu, Sekolah Menengah Oton Nasional di Barangay Caboloan Sur, Kotamadya Oton, Provinsi Iloilo dari Sekolah Menengah Oton Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cambitu Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Cambitu, Sekolah Menengah Oton Kebangsaan di Barangay Caboloan Sur, Perbandaran Oton, Wilayah Iloilo daripada Sekolah Menengah Oton Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cambitu Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Oton National High School – Cambitu Extension in Barangay Caboloan Sur, Municipality of Oton, Province of Iloilo is hereby separated from the Oton National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Cambitu National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Oton National High School–Cambitu Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cambitu National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Cambitu National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Oton National High School–Cambitu Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
